Forecast Discussion

A front moved across the Southern Appalachians today from NW to SE. Meanwhile, a cluster of showers and thundershowers with a period of heavy rain rode the front from SW to NE this morning. Scattered showers and thunderstorms redevelop this afternoon, lingering into the evening.

Saturday, the front slowly moves to our east. A NW flow develops. A shower or two is possible mostly on the west side of the Appalachians during the daytime Saturday. A shower or two remains possible (mostly west) as the cooler air settles in Saturday night.

Sunday through Tuesday... Oh, you are going to love it. The peak of the cool will be Monday morning. Sunday has a NW wind and cooler temperatures. Winds diminish by Monday afternoon. Tuesday is less chilly as high pressure moves to our east. But, it's dry, pleasant weather throughout.

Wednesday, the front returns northward, adding warmth and humidity with widely scattered showers and thundershowers Wednesday afternoon and evening. The next front from the northwest arrives Thursday with more widespread showers and thundershowers. Next Friday looks drier and pleasant.
